results.extra: Working out, against the adapter's accounting file, what became of each part of each source record.

results.extra: Putting the facts about a record into the store its queries run over.

results.name: fhir-r4-synthea-lifetime-4f159b52/stage/index
results.extra: Building the lookup structure that compiled queries read, from a record's triples. A query the general evaluator answers needs none.
